Data extraction: DTD element declarations as KeyValue nodes

```python title="Python"

def main() -> None:
    source = "<!ELEMENT server (host, port)>\n<!ELEMENT host (#PCDATA)>\n"
    config = {"data_extraction": True, "language": "dtd"}
    result = process(source, config)
    print(result.data)
    print(result.data.kind)

main()
```
